name: processed_distance
remarks: Reading starts ranging. Sensor applies its algorithm before returning distance

name: realtime_distance
remarks: Reading starts one ranging cycle and returns the real-time distance

name: temperature
remarks: Resolution 0.5 °C, unsigned 16-bit in both tables. Negative encoding undocumented

name: echo_time
remarks: Reading triggers a measurement. Divide microseconds by 5.75 for approximate mm

name: slave_address
remarks: DFRobot gives default 0x01 and broadcast 0xFF. Standard Modbus unicast is 1..247 and broadcast is 0
source: DFRobot EN/CN register table 2 and Modbus Serial Line V1.02 §2.2

name: switch_output_polarity
remarks: Output below threshold is low for 0 and high for 1 (default). Switch mode only, no switch pin shown on either RS485 cable

name: switch_distance_threshold
remarks: Switch mode only. No factory threshold specified
source: DFRobot table 2 (SEN0591 CN and SEN0592 EN/CN)

name: angle_level
remarks: Approximate angles in level order 1..4. Default 4. Higher settings widen detection and increase sensitivity
source: DFRobot EN/CN register table 2 (SEN0592 axes from CN)

name: output_distance_unit
remarks: 0=mm, 1=µs. Applies to automatic and controlled UART output. No factory setting specified

name: power_noise_reduction_level
remarks: Default 1. Increasing this level increases suppression and its effect on the detection angle

name: max_range_level
remarks: SEN0591 default 4. SEN0592 default 5. SEN0591 is rated to 300 cm
